query:
SELECT ?item ?prop ?date ?dateProp ?precision WHERE {
  ?item ?p wd:Q22686 .
  ?prop wikibase:directClaim ?p .
  VALUES (?dateProp ?value) {
    (p:P585 psv:P585)
    (p:P577 psv:P577)
    (p:P580 psv:P580)
    (p:P571 psv:P571)
  }
  ?item ?dateProp ?st .
  ?st a wikibase:BestRank ; ?value ?v .
  ?v wikibase:timeValue ?date ; wikibase:timePrecision ?precision .
}
ORDER BY ?date ?item ?prop
LIMIT 5000
OFFSET 0
